name: vani
description: VANI — Visualizing Academic Networks and Ideas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @vani/api" "npm run dev -w @vani/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && npm run build -w @vani/web && npm run build -w @vani/extension
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run test -w @vani/api && npm run test -w @vani/web && npm run test -w @vani/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vani/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vani/api && npm run typecheck -w @vani/web && npm run typecheck -w @vani/extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.extension:package: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run package -w @vani/extension
scripts.extension:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/extension && node scripts/extension-smoke.mjs
scripts.research:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && node scripts/research-smoke.mjs
scripts.workspace:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && node scripts/workspace-smoke.mjs
scripts.connected:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && node scripts/connected-smoke.mjs
scripts.planning:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && node scripts/planning-smoke.mjs
scripts.ingestion:smoke: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && node scripts/ingestion-smoke.mjs
